title: Degrees vs Radians
description: An interactive MicroSim comparing degrees and radians, showing how 2π radians equals 360 degrees through visual representation on a circle.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mathematics
Geometry
Trigonometry
Angle Measurement
learningObjectives: Explain why a full circle measures 360 degrees and 2π (about 6.28) radians
Identify one radian as the angle whose arc length equals the circle's radius, shown by the alternating colored arcs
Convert an angle between degrees and radians by comparing the two readouts as the slider rotates the line
Estimate an angle's radian measure by counting the colored arc segments it spans on the circumference
